class.name: EditorActionButton
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A button presentation synchronized with an [EditorAction].
class.description: Displays an [EditorAction] using the editor theme and automatically follows changes to the action's label, icon, shortcut, visibility, enabled state, and checked state.

members.member: The action represented by this button.
When [code]true[/code], uses the primary-action button presentation instead of the flat toolbar presentation.
